name: 2018 College Football Playoff
overview: The 2018 College Football Playoff delivered one of the most unforgettable conclusions in the sport’s history, marked by a miraculous quarterback change, an overtime thriller, and the crowning of a new Alabama legend. It was a postseason that blended tradition and transformation—where Alabama’s dominance remained intact, but how they achieved it rewrote expectations. With four blue-blood programs in the field: Alabama, Clemson, Georgia, and Oklahoma —the playoff was a clash of titans, culminating in one of the most iconic finishes college football has ever seen.
